    Public community facility

    Previously inspected community page publishes its cultural center at Robeline, Louisiana. Road-number discrepancy remains; no geocoding or homeland boundary inferred.

  • Alabama↗Historical migration/settlement
    Connection & source
    Historical migration/settlement

    Community account describes some Alabama/Quassarte groups moving to Louisiana. Not a single migration followed by everyone.

    Late eighteenth–early nineteenth centuries. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

  • Apalachee↗Continuing specific community connection
    Connection & source
    Continuing specific community connection

    Actual Talimali Band page explicitly locates Apalachee descendants and its organization in Pineville, Louisiana. Community self-description; no federal recognition determination.

    Present-day geography; inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Atakapa↗Historical homeland region connection
    Connection & source
    Historical homeland region connection

    Actual dated Handbook introduction identifies southwestern Louisiana and southeastern Texas. Only historical geography used; offensive labels, cannibalism assertions and disappearance claims in this older article are not adopted.

    Historical coastal/bayou communities before early nineteenth century. Reviewed 2026-10-21.
